metadata.description: Reusable Claude Code agents, skills and an OpenSpec-based workflow, split into packs you install per project.

plugins.name: devkit-core
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic dev workflow: research, plan, implement, review, ship, debug and test.

plugins.name: devkit-openspec
plugins.description: Runs the devkit flow on top of OpenSpec: the devkit and devkit-lite schemas (grill → plan → readiness → TDD → review → evidence) and hooks that keep product code closed until readiness is APPROVED and refuse a PR without an approved review and evidence.

plugins.name: devkit-design
plugins.description: Greenfield design in four DDD phases: business discovery, domain model, architecture and implementation plan.

plugins.name: devkit-stack
plugins.description: Technology references: Postgres, Neon, React performance, Vitest, multi-tenant SaaS and threat modeling.

plugins.name: devkit-ai-engineering
plugins.description: Building with LLMs: evaluation, multi-agent patterns, agent tool and CLI design, context compression and skill vetting.
